alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring every 12 months for patients on TDF. The patient's most recent creatinine was 76 umol/L on 2025-12-15 (38 days ago), but no eGFR was documented. If this creatinine was drawn as part of routine annual TDF monitoring, eGFR should also be checked. The creatinine value itself is within normal range, providing no evidence of TDF nephrotoxicity. However, incomplete renal screening leaves a monitoring gap.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm eGFR was assessed with the recent creatinine. If not, order eGFR to complete annual TDF renal monitoring requirements.
